items.text: The Knicks have won 14 straight against the Raptors, the longest streak by either team in the series (was 9, the Raptors, 2018-20) (last: 112-108 on 11/15).
The Knicks are 16-4 in the last 20 meetings with the Raptors (since 1/2/22).
Jalen Brunson's teams have won 14 straight against the Raptors with him playing.
Scottie Barnes's teams have lost 13 straight against the Knicks with him playing.
Karl-Anthony Towns's teams have won 10 straight against the Raptors with him playing.
The Knicks have won 8 straight road games against the Raptors; the Raptors last beat them at home on 1/22/23.
Scottie Barnes has averaged 15.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 26.9 in his other 7 (−11.9), the biggest drop in the NBA; the Knicks are 4th in defensive rating.
Josh Hart's teams have won 14 straight against the Raptors with him playing.
Mikal Bridges's teams have won 12 straight against the Raptors with him playing.
OG Anunoby's teams have won 9 straight against the Raptors with him playing, every game in his career.
Ja'Kobe Walter's teams have lost 10 straight against the Knicks with him playing, every game in his career.
Jakob Poeltl's teams have lost 10 straight against the Knicks with him playing.

The Raptors have scored 97.2 points per 100 possessions in 3 games against the top 5 defenses and 114.7 against everyone else (−17.5), the 2nd-biggest drop in the NBA; the Knicks are 4th in defensive rating.
The Knicks score 18.2 second-chance points a game (the most); the Raptors allow 17.0 (5th most). Karl-Anthony Towns scores 3.7 (6th in the NBA); Jalen Brunson scores 3.7 (6th in the NBA).
Ja'Kobe Walter has averaged 15.3 points in 3 games against the top 5 defenses and 9.4 in his other 10 (+5.9), the 4th-biggest rise in the NBA; the Knicks are 4th in defensive rating.
All-time: the Raptors lead the Knicks 61-59 in the regular season; the Raptors are 35-25 at home in it (through 11/16/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Jonathan Kuminga's teams are 12-2 against the Trail Blazers in games he's played in his career.

The Trail Blazers have scored 107.9 points per 100 possessions in 4 games against the top 5 defenses and 118.3 against everyone else (−10.4), the 5th-biggest drop in the NBA; the Timberwolves are 1st in defensive rating.
Sidy Cissoko has averaged 11.3 points in 4 games against the top 5 defenses and 6.0 in his other 9 (+5.3), the 5th-biggest rise in the NBA; the Timberwolves are 1st in defensive rating.
Terrence Shannon Jr. had 34 points against the Trail Blazers on 11/16 (won).
Rudy Gobert had 18 points, 15 rebounds against the Trail Blazers on 11/16 (won).
The Timberwolves lead the season series 1-0 (Timberwolves 106-98 on 11/16).

All-time: the Trail Blazers lead the Timberwolves 93-51 in the regular season; the Timberwolves are 33-39 at home in it (through 11/16/26; the Timberwolves' media guide, and a count of the games agrees)
Largest wins in the series: the Timberwolves by 43 (124-81 on 3/7/22); the Trail Blazers by 30 (121-91 on 3/30/91).
Daniss Jenkins has averaged 7.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 14.4 in his other 10 (−7.4), the 9th-biggest drop in the NBA; the Spurs are 2nd in defensive rating.
The Spurs score 17.8 second-chance points a game (3rd most); the Pistons allow 17.0 (5th most). Victor Wembanyama scores 4.7 (3rd in the NBA).
John Collins has averaged 4.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 11.7 in his other 10 (−7.7), the 6th-biggest drop in the NBA; the Spurs are 2nd in defensive rating.
Javonte Green has averaged 11.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 5.0 in his other 10 (+6.0), the 3rd-biggest rise in the NBA; the Spurs are 2nd in defensive rating.
All-time: the Spurs lead the Pistons 67-39 in the regular season; the Spurs are 39-14 at home in it (through 11/16/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Spurs by 39 (114-75 on 3/3/13); the Pistons by 34 (132-98 on 12/1/19).
